nurse.text: Well, hello there, love. Welcome to the Lancaster Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter and I'll have a look.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yourself down. There's a brew on, and a fruit scone if you ask nicely. Your creatures are in good hands.
All done. They're fighting fit and a bit smug about it. Go on, off with you. Mind the canal.
The Ark? It's the terminal by the window. It runs on a very old computer and a lot of faith.

else.text: Right you are. Pop back any time. We're warmer than the castle, and the tea's better.
